subject: Tourism
provisional_note: Semester 1 (Jul-Dec 2026) follows the official MoEST 2026 calendar. Semester 2 (Jan-May 2027) is inferred from the 2026 pattern and ends before the ACSEE examinations - replace it with the published 2026/2027 almanac before relying on those dates.

entries.main_competence: 2.0 Demonstrate mastery in principles of sustainable tourism
entries.specific_competence: 2.2 Understand the concept of conservation, management and   protection of tourism resources
entries.learning_activity: (a) Describe basic concepts of tourism resources (natural and cultural resources focusing on significance, threats and mitigation measures)
teaching_learning_activities: Brainstorming: Organize students in groups to brainstorm meaning of tourism resources
Group discussion: Guide students to discuss tourism resources (types, significance, threats and mitigation measures)
Project activity: Guide students to initiate a tree nursery as a strategy for managing threats to natural resources. Later, allow students to select a proper season and location for planting trees
Guest speaker: Invite a heritage expert/practitioner to share with student on heritage conservation techniques. Let students relate to heritage sustainability.
Multimedia source: With the aid of video or online sources, allow students to explore various types of threats to natural resources
Storytelling Techniques: Allow students to tell compelling stories about cultural experiences of a destination
Virtual learning: Organize and allow students to attend various virtual training
Debate: Organise students to participate in discussion on conservation and protection of tourism resources
entries.assessment: Basic concepts of tourism resources are described
resources: pictures and videos showing various types of tourism resources
entries.references: TIE, Tourism for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Six: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.main_competence: 2.0 Demonstrate mastery in principles of sustainable tourism
entries.specific_competence: 2.2 Understand the concept of conservation, management and   protection of tourism resources
entries.learning_activity: (b) Describe protected areas (categories, importance, challenges and management strategies)
teaching_learning_activities: Case study: Organize students in groups and provide a case study that portrays challenges such as fire, poaching, human -wildlife conflicts, encroachment and significance of protected areas
Guest speaker: Invite a resource person from any conservation institutions to elaborate protected areas
Field trip: Organize a field trip to a protected area and allow student to explore categories and management
entries.assessment: Protected areas are described
resources: GPS. compass direction and pictures showing protected areas
entries.references: TIE, Tourism for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Six: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education
